facts.text: Server::Server constructs the spawn and delete action servers on the public node handle with the relative names stdr_server/spawn_robot and stdr_server/delete_robot.
stdr_server.h includes the generated stdr_msgs/SpawnRobotAction and stdr_msgs/DeleteRobotAction headers.
stdr_server.h aliases SpawnRobotServer and DeleteRobotServer to actionlib::SimpleActionServer over stdr_msgs::SpawnRobotAction and stdr_msgs::DeleteRobotAction.
activateActionServers starts the spawn, register and delete action servers.
The constructor starts the action servers only when it receives a map path as argv, or after load_static_map/load_static_map_external constructs a MapServer; without a map it skips activation.
spawnRobotCallback aborts a goal whose sensor frame_id values repeat, otherwise calls addNewRobot; on success it sets the goal succeeded and publishes the active robot list.

addNewRobot defaults an empty kinematicModel.type to ideal, assigns the name robot<N> from a monotonically increasing server counter, loads a stdr_robot/Robot nodelet, and waits up to 5.0 s for the robot to register.
addNewRobot returns a nonempty message when the robot does not register within the 5.0 s wait; spawnRobotCallback then aborts the goal.
deleteRobotCallback calls deleteRobot; on success it publishes the active robot list and sets the goal succeeded, and it aborts the goal otherwise.
deleteRobot erases a robot only when the unload nodelet service returns success and reports that same boolean in the action result.
The server advertises the latched stdr_msgs::RobotIndexedVectorMsg active robot list on the relative topic stdr_server/active_robots with queue size 10.
stdr_msgs/RobotIndexedMsg carries the assigned robot name and the stdr_msgs/RobotMsg description.
stdr_msgs/RobotIndexedVectorMsg carries an array of stdr_msgs/RobotIndexedMsg entries.
SpawnRobot.action defines a stdr_msgs/RobotMsg description goal and a RobotIndexedMsg indexedDescription plus string message result.
DeleteRobot.action defines a string name goal and a bool success result.

The upstream functional test drives the relative names stdr_server/spawn_robot, stdr_server/delete_robot and stdr_server/active_robots with SpawnRobotAction, DeleteRobotAction and RobotIndexedVectorMsg.

stdr_server advertises the load_static_map/load_static_map_external and add/delete source services and activates only the spawn, register and delete action servers; no pause, resume, reset or stop service or action is advertised.
The robot nodelet advertises the relative <name>/replace MoveRobot service.
Robot::moveRobotCallback rejects a colliding or unknown-occupancy pose and otherwise sets the current pose; it is not a stop.
The upstream functional test builds a RobotMsg with only footprint.radius and initialPose, spawns it, reads indexedDescription.name and checks the same entry on the active robot list.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned action/server replies; placeholder robot names and descriptions do not establish world state, trajectory or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free recording transport: it answers the declared spawn and active_robots endpoints and runs no stdr_server, nodelet manager, map, robot, sensor, kinematics, collision or physics loop
the fake maintains a placeholder robot registry whose names and entries are test data; a live run must reach the operator's stdr_server with a loaded map
the upstream action servers start only after a map is supplied or one of the load-map services succeeds; the fake does not model that precondition
the upstream spawn waits up to 5.0 s for the robot nodelet to register; the fake answers immediately and performs no nodelet lifecycle action

the package exposes no step, pause, reset, map load, velocity or sensor capability beyond the active robot list; delete_robot is also unbound because the server advertises no acknowledged stop for the actions
